title: meliosma alba
intro: Meliosma alba, commonly known as the White Meliosma or Sabah White Meliosma, is a plant species in the family Alismataceae, native to Borneo. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Meliosma alba include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Meliosma alba include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which have been isolated and studied for their potential medicinal properties.
